Hero.title: KALAP GRAM
Hero.subtitle: GURUKULAM ASHRAM
Hero.description: An ancient tapobhoomi and spiritual retreat on the sacred banks of Maa Narmada

About.title: Welcome to an Ancient Tapobhoomi
About.description_1: Kalap Gram Gurukulam Ashram was established in 1996 on the sacred banks of Maa Narmada in the village of Surela Kishor by Param Pujya Swami Somendra Teerth Maharaj Ji.
About.description_2: Swami Somendra Teerth Maharaj Ji is a highly revered saint of the Shaktipat tradition and a Sannyasi of the Shankaracharya tradition.

Philosophy.description: Here, nature is not merely a part of the ashram, but an integral part of the spiritual atmosphere.

Tapobhoomi.title: The Spiritual Heritage of an Ancient Tapobhoomi
Tapobhoomi.description: According to tradition, this land is associated with Maharishi Shandilya. It is believed that this tapobhoomi is deeply ancient and spiritually awakened. It is said that meditating here brings a unique spiritual energy.

GuruParampara.title: Guru Parampara & Guru Kripa
GuruParampara.subtitle: Param Pujya Swami Somendra Teerth Maharaj Ji
GuruParampara.description: Swami Somendra Teerth Maharaj Ji is an exalted saint of the Shaktipat tradition and a Sannyasi of the Shankaracharya tradition. The Guru-Shishya tradition highly values sadhana, discipline, and direct experience. Without the grace of the Guru, this inner journey is impossible.

Narmada.title: The Sacred Presence of Maa Narmada
Narmada.description: The sandy banks of the Narmada River, the chirping of birds, the presence of peacocks and deer, and the shade of ancient trees create a serene environment that is ideal for meditation and silence.

Silence.title: Here, Silence is a Sadhana
Silence.description: The flow of the Narmada, the shade of the trees, the sound of the birds, and the surrounding peace provide an environment that slowly leads the mind inward.

shrividya.title: Shri Vidya Sadhana
shrividya.desc: The sadhana, mantras, meditation, and worship of the Shri Vidya tradition.

shaktipat.title: Shaktipat Sadhana
shaktipat.desc: The awakening of consciousness and the inner journey in the Guru-Shishya tradition.

ashirwad.title: Ashirwad Vidya
ashirwad.desc: Blessings, intention (sankalpa), spiritual touch, and subtle sadhana.

vigyan_bhairav.title: Vigyan Bhairav Tantra
vigyan_bhairav.desc: The practice of turning inward through various meditation techniques and experiments.

pranayama.title: Pranayama
pranayama.desc: Balancing the prana and the mind through yogic breathing exercises.

yogasana.title: Yogasana
yogasana.desc: Practices to make the body healthy, stable, and conducive for deep meditation.

mudra.title: Mudra Sadhana
mudra.desc: Practices to establish harmony between the body, breath, mind, and meditation.

Seva.title: Annakshetra — The Tradition of Seva
Seva.quote: “Service with Sadhana, and Sadhana with Service”
Seva.description: Kalap Gram Gurukulam Ashram operates an Annakshetra (free food kitchen) for saints, sadhus, and Narmada Parikrama pilgrims.

SpiritualFamily.title: Your Spiritual Family
SpiritualFamily.description: Kalap Gram Gurukulam Ashram is an opportunity to connect with Guru's grace, sadhana, seva, nature, and higher spiritual consciousness.

Visit.title: Welcome to the Sacred Banks of Maa Narmada
Visit.location: Gram Surela Kishor, on the banks of Maa Narmada
